d: Bablu Dablu Cubs is a brand-new edutainment series showing children that learning can be fun. At this scenic Pine Tree Kindergarten, all the cubs observe the world in their own creative and wondrous ways.
Chingum, an honest and hardworking police inspector, fights crime and attempts to keep his city safe. He also helps his friends, Motu and Patlu, overcome various obstacles.
Twenty years ago, it was “The king of top” Mete that created the peak of top competition and made this competition a sudden craze among the world. He is also the founder of the Top school.

A shy and brave boy, Nori, lives in the famous amusement park, Nori Park. Nori wants to be the star of rollercoasters and a hero, like his father Dragon Rider, who is the king of racing and looks great on the track rollercoaster in Nori Park.
The Lion King is shot by poachers, as part of Shere Khan the Bengal tiger's plot to overthrow the king from his throne.
